## Fact-check notes
- Meta expects to spend up to $72 billion on AI infrastructure in 2026; Microsoft signed a $17.4 billion GPU capacity deal with Nebius Group; OpenAI signed $1 trillion in total AI infrastructure deals including a $100 billion agreement with NVIDIA (source: Network World, company announcements)
- Alibaba will invest at least $52 billion in AI infrastructure over three years; Google will invest $40 billion in three new data centers through 2027; Amazon is investing up to $50 billion to expand AI and supercomputing capabilities (source: Network World, company announcements)
- Deloitte identifies agentic AI as a top trend driving AI compute needs, speculating it could overtake SaaS tools (source: Deloitte research via Network World)
- AI mentions appeared in 51.6% of November Hacker News 'Who is Hiring?' posts, up from 30% two years ago; AI agent mentions (14.8%) now outrank LLMs (10.7%) (source: HNTrends via AI Weekly)
